title: Latam’s cultural export fuels La Sordera’s cross-border growth
summary: When La Sordera began promoting shows for Venezuelan expats in Chile a decade ago, its business was rooted in connecting communities. That purpose remains today, its principals tell IQ, though the operation has scaled to produce and promote more than 500 shows across Europe and Latin America, building a multinational business that helps artists, management, and touring teams navigate the complex trade between the two regions. summary: Calvin Harris has established a new benchmark for electronic touring in Australia, with over 330,000 tickets flying out for his debut run in the market, according to promoters. summary: After 20 years at the company, Tim McGregor will depart Australasian live giant Ticketek Entertainment Group (TEG) amid a ‘strategic reset’ led by CEO Cameron Hoy.
